//: Merge into <project>/.tabnine/agent/settings.json. enableAgents turns on custom subagents (agents/twin-builder.md). The AfterAgent hook is optional: it fires once when the agent finishes a turn — never per tool call — runs the repo's OWN build checks, and on failure returns decision=deny so the agent gets the build output and keeps working. Requires jq. Swap the gradle task for your build (mvn -q verify).

hooks.name: build-checks
hooks.description: Repo build checks must be green before the agent is done
hooks.command: bash -c 'O=$(./gradlew -q check 2>&1) || jq -n --arg r "$O" '"'"'{decision:"deny",reason:("Build checks failed. Fix the code at the root cause — do not edit rulesets, thresholds or add suppressions.\n\n"+$r)}'"'"''
